context_requirements: Expression of acetylcholinesterase (ACHE) or butyrylcholinesterase (BCHE) in the assayed cell line
An intact cholinergic signaling pathway that can be modulated by enzyme inhibition
Sufficient intracellular acetylcholine or choline metabolite pools to alter downstream signaling
falsifiers: Reproducible, dose-dependent changes in landmark gene expression at 6 h or 24 h after treatment with a cholinesterase inhibitor in any of the nine cell lines
Enrichment of cholinergic or acetylcholinesterase-related transcriptional signatures in the expression profiles
Consistent upregulation of immediate-early genes (e.g., FOS, JUN, EGR1) across multiple cell lines at 6 h
